title: I've been working on a roguelite deckbuilder about running a fantasy coffee trailer ☕️ Free demo out now!
author: ShotCategory6583
selftext:
I just released the free demo for my AI-assisted roguelite deckbuilder, Roast Story! ☕️

Roast Story is a roguelite deckbuilder where you caffeinate the heroes of a fantasy world from your traveling coffee trailer.

The demo includes both Story Mode and Legacy Mode, and is available now on itch:

https://stripeycatgames.itch.io/roast-story

I’ve had a lot of fun building this one with AI, especially seeing how far the models can take the coding and content side of a game like this. There’s still plenty I’m working on, so I’d love to hear what you think of the demo gameplay, presentation, UI, whatever stands out.

Also happy to provide keys to streamers/reviewers who want to check it out. ❤️

comments.author: Brapchu
comments.body: Always that yellow pee filter over everything..

replies.author: Leoporix
replies.body: For a coffee-themed piece, this color choice seems appropriate. Personally, I think the artwork is pretty cool. The anachronism is what bothers me the most, but it could be seen as a deliberate stylistic choice.
